exercises.title: Set up the black pieces
exercises.instruction: Black begins on the three rows nearest you. Tap the three gaps in Black's starting position.

feedback.initial: Find and replace the three missing black pieces.
feedback.success: Black now has all 12 starting pieces.
feedback.invalidPiece: That square already has a piece. Find an empty gap.
feedback.invalidDestination: That is not a gap in Black's starting rows.

exercises.title: Set up the white pieces
exercises.instruction: White begins on the three rows nearest you. Tap the three gaps in White's starting position.

feedback.initial: Find and replace the three missing white pieces.
feedback.success: White now has all 12 starting pieces.
feedback.invalidPiece: That square already has a piece. Find an empty gap.
feedback.invalidDestination: That is not a gap in White's starting rows.

exercises.title: Make Black's first move
exercises.instruction: Black moves first. Select a black checker, then move it diagonally forward to an empty dark square.

feedback.initial: Select a black piece that can move.
feedback.success: Legal move. Black moves forward toward the far side of the board.
feedback.invalidPiece: Select a black piece that has a legal forward diagonal move.
feedback.invalidDestination: Select a black piece that has a legal forward diagonal move.

exercises.title: Reply as White
exercises.instruction: Turns alternate. Select a white checker and make one legal forward diagonal move.

feedback.initial: Now select a white piece that can move.
feedback.success: Legal move. White moves forward toward the far side of the board.
feedback.invalidPiece: Select a white piece that has a legal forward diagonal move.
feedback.invalidDestination: Select a white piece that has a legal forward diagonal move.
